title: Valuation MBA Spring 2025
description:
This is an MBA class on valuing and pricing just about everything (from stocks to businesses to sports franchises) that I will be teaching at New York University's Stern School of Business in the spring of 2025. The first session is scheduled for January 27, 2025, and will contain 26 sessions, with the last session on May 5, 2025. We will meet twice a week, on Mondays & Wednesdays, with the recordings showing up shortly after. While only NYU students enrolled in the class can attend the live sessions, the recorded sessions will be available to everyone, with no password or registration required. Each video will also provide links to supplementary materials (slides, post class tests) for the session. The additional material for the class can be found on the webpage for the class:
Website for class: http://www.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/equity.html
